verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a first-party help article titled "Calendar events and invitations", and a community user refers to "your Fastmail calendar". That indicates a native calendar with event and invitation handling. The pack gives only the title, with no detail on how it works or on use inside the mail client. Missing for 10: documented viewing of the calendar inside the mail interface, documented RSVP/response to invites from email, documented event creation, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see my calendar, respond to invites, and create events without leaving the email client

citations.quote: you can add your Fastmail calendar to Google Calendar
